review_notes: I read the whole file. I grepped Mathlib for other uses and definitions of IsFractional, FractionalIdeal.den/num, equivNum*, coeSubmodule and the unaryCast NatCast pattern. I found nothing outside the FractionalIdeal files that defines a competing concept. The file's structural declarations either reuse existing Mathlib notions or are deliberate specialisations. FractionalIdeal is a subtype of Submodule R P, with SetLike, lattice and commSemiring structure transferred through Function.Injective.*. coeIdeal is built from IsLocalization.coeSubmodule. coeToSubmodule is a named coercion. coeSubmoduleHom and coeIdealHom are bundled ring homs. IsFractional is the file's own predicate and is stated using IsLocalization.IsInteger. The Min/Max/Add/Mul/Pow definitions exist so that the result is shown to be fractional. The NatCast through Nat.unaryCast is the standard idiom. I saw no concrete duplicated API or repeated-conversion cost that would justify consolidation, so I abstain.
